title: Project
description: Root of an EditsEditor project file.

root.description: Id of the composition that is rendered/exported.

compositions.description: Compositions by id. Compositions can be nested via `{"type": "comp"}` clip sources.

assets.description: Imported media and resource files by id.

timing.description: Musical timing (beats, drops, sections) used by expressions, snapping and presets.

custom_effects.description: Project-defined custom effects (WGSL), same format as built-in effects.

custom_presets.description: Project-defined presets (Rhai scripts with a `//!` TOML header), same format as built-ins.

variables.description: Global variables readable from expressions via `var("name")`.

script_library.description: Shared Rhai function library available to every expression and script.

notes.description: Free-form notes (e.g. the agent's plan for the edit).

tracks.description: Tracks, bottom to top: later tracks are composited over earlier ones.

effects.description: Effects applied to the final composited image of this composition.

motion_blur.description: Motion blur settings for clips that enable `motion_blur`.

solo.description: Solo this track (audio + video): only soloed tracks render when any track is soloed.

effects.description: Effects applied to this track's composited result.

Property_double.description: Animatable property: a static value, or {keyframes, expr, value, loop}.

value.description: Base value when there are no keyframes (used with `expr`).

expr.description:
Rhai expression evaluated every frame. Has access to `value` (keyframed value), `t`,
`time`, beat/audio helpers and more (see the expression reference).

loop.description: Repeat the keyframed section after the last keyframe.

Keyframe_double.description: Keyframe: {t, v, ease} or [t, v, ease]. t = clip-local seconds; ease shapes the segment to the next key.

oneOf.description: Holds the current value until the next keyframe (jump cut on values).
Very sharp in-out curve used for velocity edits / whip moves (bezier 0.9,0,0.1,1).
Fast start that settles hard — great for zoom punches (bezier 0.05,0.7,0.1,1).
Custom cubic bezier like CSS `cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)`.
Overshoot ("back") with custom overshoot amount (default style is 1.70158).
Damped spring. Interpreted in seconds over the keyframe segment.
Elastic with custom amplitude and period.
Repeat keyframes from the first to the last.
Only shows where the destination has alpha (stencil).
Cuts out the destination where this layer has alpha.

effect.description: Effect id from the library (`effects_list`), or a project custom effect id.

params.description: Parameter values by name. Missing params use the effect's defaults.

mix.description: Mix between the unprocessed (0) and processed (1) image.

range.description: Only apply within this clip-local time range [start, end] (seconds).

Property_Value.description: Animatable property: a static value, or {keyframes, expr, value, loop}.

Value.description:
A loosely-typed parameter value.

- numbers: `0.5`
- vectors / colors as arrays: `[0.2, 0.4]`, `[1, 0, 0, 1]`
- booleans: `true`
- strings: colors (`"#ff00aa"`), enum options (`"radial"`), asset ids, text

value.description: Base value when there are no keyframes (used with `expr`).

expr.description:
Rhai expression evaluated every frame. Has access to `value` (keyframed value), `t`,
`time`, beat/audio helpers and more (see the expression reference).

loop.description: Repeat the keyframed section after the last keyframe.

Keyframe_Value.description: Keyframe: {t, v, ease} or [t, v, ease]. t = clip-local seconds; ease shapes the segment to the next key.

hidden.description: Hidden clips don't render directly but can be used as mattes (`matte.clip`).

speed.description:
Playback speed (1 = normal, 0.25 = slow-mo, 3 = fast). Animatable: keyframing speed
creates smooth velocity ramps — source time is the integral of speed.

time_remap.description: Absolute time remap: maps clip-local time -> source time (seconds). Overrides `in`/`speed`.

reverse.description: Play the source backwards (from the out-point to the in-point).

freeze.description: Freeze on a single source time (seconds).

end_behavior.description: What happens when the source runs out.

fit.description: How media is sized into the composition before the transform.

crop.description: Crop in source pixels fractions: [left, top, right, bottom] in 0..1.

effects.description: Effect stack, applied in order (in composition space, after the transform).

matte.description: Use another clip's alpha/luma as this clip's matte.

transition_in.description: Transition from the previous clip on the same track, starting at this clip's start.

motion_blur.description: Enable sub-frame motion blur (settings on the composition).

echo.description: Temporal echo / trails: re-renders the clip at earlier times and blends them in.

oneOf.description: Any imported asset: video, image, animated image (gif/webp/apng), svg, image sequence, audio.

no_audio.description: Disable the asset's audio for this clip.

no_video.description: Disable the asset's video for this clip (audio only).

oneOf.description: Rich text with optional per-character animation.
Procedural generator effect (noise, speed lines, particles, gradients, ...).
Applies this clip's effects to everything composited below it.

Property_Color.description: Animatable property: a static value, or {keyframes, expr, value, loop}.

value.description: Base value when there are no keyframes (used with `expr`).

expr.description:
Rhai expression evaluated every frame. Has access to `value` (keyframed value), `t`,
`time`, beat/audio helpers and more (see the expression reference).

loop.description: Repeat the keyframed section after the last keyframe.

Keyframe_Color.description: Keyframe: {t, v, ease} or [t, v, ease]. t = clip-local seconds; ease shapes the segment to the next key.

width.description: Stroke width in pixels (outside the glyph).

TextAnimator.description: Animates text units from a "from" state into place (and optionally out again).

duration.description: Animation duration of each unit (seconds). 0 = instant (typewriter).

start.description: Local time at which the in-animation starts.

from.description: Starting state of each unit (animates to rest).

out.description: Optional exit animation, ending at the clip end.

wave.description: Continuous sine wave offset per unit: [amplitude_px, frequency_hz, phase_per_unit].

jitter.description: Random per-unit jitter in pixels, changing `jitter_rate` times per second (glitchy text).

font.description: Font family name (system font or imported font asset family). Fallbacks are automatic.

letter_spacing.description: Extra spacing between characters (pixels). Animatable (tracking animation).

oneOf.description: SVG path data in local pixels (centered at 0,0).

angle.description: Angle in degrees for linear gradients.

offset.description: Offset (0..1) rotating where the path starts.

trim.description: Trim paths: draw only [start, end] fraction of the outline (stroke draw-on animations).

oneOf.description: Render nothing once the source ends.

position.description: Offset of the layer center from the composition center (pixels).

anchor.description: Anchor point offset from the layer center (pixels, layer space). Rotation/scale pivot.

rotation_x.description: 3D rotation around the X axis (degrees) — tilts toward/away from camera.

z.description: Depth in pixels (positive = further away = smaller).

perspective.description: Camera distance for perspective (pixels). Default ≈ 1.2 × composition width.

Property_Vec2.description: Animatable property: a static value, or {keyframes, expr, value, loop}.

value.description: Base value when there are no keyframes (used with `expr`).

expr.description:
Rhai expression evaluated every frame. Has access to `value` (keyframed value), `t`,
`time`, beat/audio helpers and more (see the expression reference).

loop.description: Repeat the keyframed section after the last keyframe.

Keyframe_Vec2.description: Keyframe: {t, v, ease} or [t, v, ease]. t = clip-local seconds; ease shapes the segment to the next key.

oneOf.description: Fit inside the composition, preserving aspect ratio.

expansion.description: Grow (+) or shrink (-) the mask in pixels.

offset.description: Offset applied to the mask shape (pixels).

MaskShape.description: Mask geometry in composition pixels relative to the composition center.

oneOf.description: Closed polygon (up to 64 points), composition pixels relative to center.
SVG path data (`M 0 0 C ...`), composition pixels relative to center. Flattened to a polygon.

clip.description: Clip id whose rendered layer is used as the matte (often a `hidden` clip).

effect.description: Transition effect id (kind = "transition" in the library).

duration.description: Duration in seconds, starting at the clip's start.

centered.description:
Center the transition on the cut (starts `duration/2` before the clip start). Requires the
previous clip to overlap or have source handles.

blend.description: How echoes combine with each other.

behind.description: Draw echoes behind (true) or over (false) the main frame.

effects.description: Audio effects (lowpass, highpass, echo, distortion, bitcrush, stutter...).

oneOf.description: Low-pass filter (muffled "underwater" sound when cutoff is low). Animatable cutoff (Hz).
Repeat short slices (stutter edit). `slice` seconds, repeats within [start, end] local time.

samples.description: Number of sub-frame samples (1 = off). 8-16 looks great for fast zooms/shakes.

shutter_angle.description: Shutter angle in degrees (180 = film look, 360 = maximum smear).

path.description:
File path (absolute, or relative to the project file). For image sequences use a pattern
like `frames/img_%04d.png` or a directory.

duration.description: Duration in seconds (None for still images).

Timing.description: Musical structure of the edit. Filled by audio analysis (`analyze_audio` with apply) or by hand.

source.description: Asset id of the music track the timing was derived from.

offset.description: Offset added to all beat times (seconds), e.g. if the music clip starts later in the timeline.

beats.description: Beat times (seconds, timeline time = value + offset).

accents.description: Strong onsets (snares, hits) that aren't necessarily on the beat grid.
